name: server refuses a 1-character and a 5-character password at sign-up
detail: 422/422 Password should be at least 8 characters.

name: server password minimum is at least the app minimum of 8 characters (a 6- and 7-character password are refused)
detail: 6 chars: 422, 7 chars: 422 (the app screens refuse under 8, so a call made straight to the API is held to a weaker rule)

name: the same e-mail cannot be registered twice (no duplicate account)
detail: second signup 422 User already registered | original still signs in: 200

name: a new self-registered account has no staff or farmer rights until approved
detail: roles []; program insert 400; other people visible 0

name: a token signed with the wrong secret, claiming to be service_role, is refused
detail: 401 No suitable key or wrong key type

name: a token with algorithm "none" is refused
a signed-in user cannot change their own role claim by updating their auth metadata
a wrong password and an unknown account give the same answer at sign-in (no account enumeration)
password-reset request answers the same for a known and an unknown e-mail
a signed-in Farmer changing their password through the API is possible only with their own session (not for someone else)
detail: admin endpoint with a user token: 403; original password still works: 200

name: 10 wrong passwords in a row lock the account; the 11th attempt with the CORRECT password is refused with a clear message
detail: wrong x10: 400 | correct password now: 400 "Too many failed sign-in attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again."

name: another account is not affected by the lock
a correct sign-in before the limit clears the count (9 wrong, 1 right, then 9 more wrong does not lock)
detail: right after 9 wrong: 200, right after 9 more wrong: 200

name: the failure log cannot be read or written through the public API (no one can unlock or lock an account from outside)
the hook function cannot be called by a signed-in user or by anyone signed out
a Manager (service) clearing the rows unlocks the account at once
